story.title: The Moon Walk
story.summary: A four-page sample story in loose, scribbly graphite pencil: a child and a parent go out after supper to find the moon.

slots.label: The child
slots.description: A child about 3 to 10 years old, the main character on every page
slots.outfit: a chunky knitted jumper, dungarees and wellington boots

slots.label: A parent
slots.description: A mum, dad or other grown-up who comes along
slots.outfit: a long wool coat, a scarf and walking boots

styleWords: very loose, scribbly black-and-white graphite pencil sketch on off-white paper: quick wobbly overlapping strokes, unerased construction lines, sparse scribbled hatching, lots of bare paper, no polished rendering, no colour
